authoring_method: Existing connection reviews and finite counterpart proposals were used as investigation leads, then raw STL triangle-plane sections, one common source Configuration, whole-group compatibility and captured manufacturer mechanism drawings were actually checked. Production counts do not form the independent relationship acceptance denominator.
scope: 70 source Part instances and 211 existing ConnectionReviews are inventoried. 40 additional concrete pair investigations preserve 12 bounded four-hole screw hypotheses and 28 insufficient outcomes, alongside the original 3 hypotheses/5 investigations. 247 finite inner-wall annotations span 37 source instances; 37 hip/core sections plus 192 extra pair sections were directly recomputed from original STL. Unreviewed source regions and noncircular mechanisms remain open.

independence.denominator: Independently re-intersected raw source sections at finite local positions; seven separately selected relationship acceptance cases (six left-hip outcomes and the previously undeclared left ankle) require concrete reviewed mechanisms or specific investigated deficiencies. The all-70 inventory is not a completion claim.
limitations: This finite sample tests omissions at known source locations; it does not establish arbitrary-direction coverage or whole-device recall.
Triangle indices are zero-based original binary-STL facet indices.
Radii are source-mesh measurements, not manufacturing tolerances.
Each item is a wall-section witness, not necessarily a distinct logical hole.

relation_studies.title: 右外壳四孔与颈部舵机的螺钉连接假设

participants.label: 右壳四个 Ø2.2 mm 通过孔
颈部舵机正 X 侧四个 Ø1.6 mm 接收孔

actions.method: Independent raw STL sections, common-configuration finite group and dimensional comparison
actions.observation: 右壳四孔 PCD 为 12 mm，对端四孔组全部间距相符。; 参考位姿每孔轴距约 0.0785 mm，有限间隔约 0.6 mm；孔径 2.2/1.6 mm 互补，不能只由邻近推断连接。

actions.method: 原件与版本核对
actions.observation: 读取模型说明、CSV 和固定 XML，核对原 STL 与源位姿；模型已简化，未对应制造 CAD，70 实例数不等于机械 BOM。

actions.method: 机械 BOM 与原始照片范围核对
actions.observation: 实际查看整机照片，目标孔背面与内部被遮挡；读取 HAT C1 表头、元件及说明，属于板级 BOM，不能提供这些机械紧固件规格。

actions.method: 上游与厂商资料实查
actions.observation: 实际查看固定前后框架、随动端和舵盘螺钉图；本轮官方 e-Manual 可读，Onshape workspace 读取仍失败，未取得 CAD。

findings: 右壳四孔 PCD 为 12 mm，对端四孔组全部间距相符。
参考位姿每孔轴距约 0.0785 mm，有限间隔约 0.6 mm；孔径 2.2/1.6 mm 互补，不能只由邻近推断连接。
missing_evidence: 实际螺钉长度、头型及螺纹尚未取得。
舵机所涉活动区、舵盘身份与最终运动归属需固定 CAD 或装配图。
选用孔数、材料、公差、预紧、载荷及连续装入路径未验证。
relation_studies.stop_reason: 已完成所列源位置与机制证据比较；具体连接假设有依据，实际紧固、公差与保持仍缺独立资料。

mechanism.summary: 螺钉通过右壳四孔进入颈部舵机一侧接收结构的夹持假设；孔组和机制有依据，实际接合尚未确认。

roles.statement: 成组通过孔与接收孔在同一源位姿中一一对应，为螺钉轴线与板件位置提供有范围的定位解释。
若有合适螺钉和接收螺纹，头部夹紧与螺纹接合可能保持；实际夹持、抗拔和承载未知。
连接后谁随动、谁固定仍需活动区与装配依据，不把整个舵机网格当成一个已知刚性连接区域。
孔壁只限定几何通行范围，未取得运动限位、螺钉允许旋入深度或装入路径依据。

supporting_evidence.claim: 原三角闭合截面支持四组有限孔壁、直径和 PCD；共同源位姿支持组距及轴线对应。
厂商舵盘螺钉图支持穿板进入接收结构的机制解释，并说明长度须依板厚另核。

counterevidence: STL 是简化的仿真外形，没有实际螺钉、螺纹或预紧力；同轴或同 body 不能单独证明夹持。
alternatives: 可能通过独立舵盘或嵌件，而非直接在所见外形壁内自攻；源模型没有分离这些活动与紧固细节。

intermediate_components.statement: 机制需要独立螺钉；数量、长度、头型、螺纹和实物 BOM 尚未确认，不生成已安装实体。
